# Conciliado

> Pay a batch of contractor invoices in USDC on Arc in one transaction, then rebuild the ledger from the chain and tie it to the wallet's balance change.

The app is a static client. There is no server, no database, and no server-held key. The payer's wallet signs every transaction. Invoice IDs stay off chain; only a salted hash goes on chain.

## Status

- Usage on 2026-11-01: 2 batches, 12 invoice lines, 0.39 USDC paid, 1 payer, 6 payees
- The USDC and transactions are real. The invoices are demo invoices, the payees are wallets made for the demo, and there are no external users yet.
- Program: Arc Microgrants: Built with Arc Studio. Video: https://youtu.be/NrJMAVy_LsI

## App

- [Landing](https://conciliado.acachete.xyz/): rebuilds a real mainnet batch in the browser, no wallet needed
- [Run a batch](https://conciliado.acachete.xyz/run): CSV review, simulation, and payment with a browser wallet
- [Metrics](https://conciliado.acachete.xyz/metrics): batches and lines read live from Arc mainnet
- [Landing as Markdown](https://conciliado.acachete.xyz/index.md)
- [Metrics as Markdown](https://conciliado.acachete.xyz/metrics.md): dated snapshot

## On chain

- Network: Arc mainnet, chain 5042
- PayoutBatch: [0xC86e2241166785344E4d6692E4D2A3D4c8466d0e](https://explorer.arc.io/address/0xC86e2241166785344E4d6692E4D2A3D4c8466d0e?tab=contract)
- Batch paid from the app: [0xd4a8008f...972665](https://explorer.arc.io/tx/0xd4a8008fc7e1179fda869206b5c14999e47bdebc22f92a6087c942650e972665)
